measurements.title: Takumi TT Level 2.1 DC / Takumi Aka MC — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.short_title: Takumi TT Level 2.1 DC / Takumi Aka MC
measurements.summary: The Takumi TT Level 2.1 DC averaged 33.33 RPM with 0.030% DIN-shaped RMS wow and flutter. The measurer observed excellent vibration rejection and moderate trackability. After azimuth adjustment, separation averaged 27.0 dB with some misalignment still present. An imperfection in this cartridge sample could also have influenced crosstalk, and the low capture level may have limited the estimate.
measurements.provenance_label: DSR measurement after azimuth adjustment with session observations on vibration rejection and trackability

measurements.title: SME Model 12 MkII / Series V / Charisma Audio MC-1 Alpha — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.short_title: SME Model 12 MkII / Series V / Charisma Audio MC-1 Alpha
measurements.summary: This SME averaged 33.32 RPM (−0.04%) with 0.038% DIN-shaped wow and flutter. The report recommends repeating the 1 kHz capture to check the 5.57 dB gap between crosstalk directions. The session took place at Entertainment Machine, DSR’s first specialised Groove Scope Studio testing point and first certified reseller in Rome.
measurements.provenance_label: DSR measurement at Entertainment Machine in Rome

measurements.title: Rega P1 / Rega Carbon — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.summary: At the AudioReview laboratory, Groove Scope revealed a 10.27 dB crosstalk imbalance on a Rega Carbon that looked square. The imbalance fell to 1.16 dB after azimuth adjustment. In a separate Groove Scope Studio test, the cartridge tracked 60 µm at 2.0 g and 80 µm at 2.5 g.
measurements.provenance_label: DSR session at the AudioReview laboratory with Groove Scope-assisted azimuth adjustment and measurer-reported tracking trials

measurements.title: Ortofon 2M Bronze / New Horizon — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.summary: Measured as found, the New Horizon setup averaged 33.41 RPM (+0.23%) with 0.053% DIN-shaped wow and flutter and 23.6 dB average 1 kHz separation. The speed fingerprints show a recurring slowdown and changes in the faster portions over eight rotations. The measurer reports no azimuth adjustment and an unsuccessful 70 µm tracking test.
measurements.provenance_label: DSR measurement session with no azimuth adjustment and a measurer-reported 70 µm tracking result

measurements.title: Audio-Technica VM95SH / Thorens TD 160 Super / SME III — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.short_title: Audio-Technica VM95SH / Thorens TD 160 Super / SME III
measurements.summary: Groove Scope made azimuth adjustment straightforward from a much worse starting position. The adjusted capture showed 17.7 dB average separation and +2.90 dB channel balance. The bent cantilever limits what those figures tell us about a VM95SH in good condition. The Thorens averaged 33.29 RPM (−0.12%) with 0.030% DIN-shaped wow and flutter. The repeating speed pattern warrants a follow-up check of the turntable.
measurements.provenance_label: DSR measurement session with measurer-reported azimuth adjustment and bent cantilever

measurements.title: Shure V15 V / JICO Custom Shop MR — Micro Seiki DQX500 / MA707 — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.short_title: Shure V15 V / JICO Custom Shop MR / Micro Seiki DQX500 / MA707
measurements.summary: An original Shure V15 V with a new JICO Custom Shop MR stylus gives an encouraging result in this Micro Seiki DQX500 / MA707 / Audio Research SP20 / Audient EVO4 capture: 33.33 RPM (−0.02%), 0.025% DIN-shaped wow and flutter, −0.01 dB channel balance and 27.3 dB average separation. THD measured 0.65% left and 0.49% right. The measurer describes clear, revealing sound before break-in and a surprisingly quiet background; the report calls for a repeat of the right-channel third-harmonic check before setup changes.
measurements.provenance_label: DSR measurement session; new JICO MR stylus and measurer-reported azimuth adjustment

measurements.title: BENZ SPJ — VYGER Atlantis / VYGER INERTIAL / ART USB Phono Plus — Hi Fidelity Milan
measurements.short_title: BENZ SPJ / VYGER Atlantis / VYGER INERTIAL / ART USB Phono Plus
measurements.summary: Measured as found in the CHARIO Academy room at Hi Fidelity Milan, with no setup adjustments: the BENZ SPJ / VYGER Atlantis / VYGER INERTIAL / ART USB Phono Plus chain averaged 33.33 RPM (−0.01%), with 0.032% DIN-shaped wow and flutter, 27.4 dB average separation and +0.49 dB channel balance. Harmonics were steady during recording. The measurer reports a successful 100 µm tracking-ladder pass and credits the new INERTIAL tonearm as a major contributor to that performance.
measurements.provenance_label: Hi Fidelity Milan — CHARIO Academy room; no setup adjustments

measurements.title: Ortofon 2M Bronze — Rega P3 / Audio Research SP20 / EVO4 — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.short_title: Ortofon 2M Bronze / Rega P3 / SP20 / EVO4
measurements.summary: The Ortofon 2M Bronze delivers strong 1 kHz separation in this Rega P3 / Audio Research SP20 / EVO4 capture: 32.8 dB on average, with +0.53 dB channel balance. Playback averaged 33.34 RPM (+0.01%) with 0.027% DIN-shaped wow and flutter. THD was 0.98% left and 1.13% right; repeat the right-channel third-harmonic check before changing setup.
measurements.provenance_label: DSR measurement session on the Rega P3 with an Audio Research SP20

measurements.title: Technics SL-1410 MK2 / Empire 7000/III — 1 kHz Playback Check
measurements.short_title: Empire 7000/III / Technics SL-1410 MK2 / ART USB Phono Plus
measurements.summary: The Technics SL-1410 MK2 averaged 33.33 RPM (−0.01%) with 0.040% DIN-shaped wow and flutter. Separation averaged 23.8 dB, but the two crosstalk directions differed by about 2 dB; channel balance was −0.26 dB. Harmonics stayed steady within this recording, while THD was higher on the left (2.26%) than the right (1.85%).
measurements.provenance_label: DSR measurement session with the ART USB Phono Plus identified in the source report

measurements.title: Goldring 2100 — Micro Seiki DQX-500 — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.summary: The DQX-500 capture averaged 33.33 RPM (−0.01%) with 0.032% DIN-shaped wow and flutter. Average 1 kHz separation was 20.1 dB and channel balance was −0.54 dB. The right-channel third harmonic changed most during recording, so the report advises repeating the capture before adjusting the cartridge setup.
measurements.provenance_label: DSR measurement session with playback chain confirmed by the measurer

measurements.title: Transfiguration Orpheus — Micro Seiki RX-5000 / SME V / EVO4 — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.short_title: Transfiguration Orpheus / Micro Seiki RX-5000 / SME V
measurements.summary: The Micro Seiki RX-5000 averaged 33.51 RPM (+0.52%) with 0.031% DIN-shaped wow and flutter. Average 1 kHz separation was 19.5 dB, channel balance was −0.35 dB, and harmonic levels were steady during this capture.
measurements.provenance_label: DSR measurement session with an EVO4 interface identified by the measurer

measurements.title: Audio-Technica AT-OC9XML — Rega P3 / Rega RB330 / Audio Research SP20 — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.summary: In this Rega P3 / RB330 capture, playback settled at 33.34 RPM (+0.02%) with 0.030% DIN-shaped wow and flutter. Average 1 kHz separation was 31.8 dB and channel balance was −0.24 dB; the left-channel third harmonic changed most during the recording, so a repeat is advisable before changing setup.
measurements.provenance_label: DSR measurement session; sample ownership not recorded
